name: Sons of Hashut

specialRules.name: Hard Head
specialRules.text: Chaos Dwarfs and Bull Centaurs ignore the special rules for maces, clubs etc.

specialRules.name: Armour
specialRules.text: Chaos Dwarfs and Bull Centaurs never suffer movement penalties for wearing armour.

specialRules.name: Hard to Kill
specialRules.text: Chaos Dwarfs and Bull Centaurs are only taken out of action on a natural 12 on the Injury chart: 1-4 knocked down, 5-11 stunned, 12 out of action.

specialRules.name: Slavers
specialRules.text: Chaos Dwarfs never free captured slaves. Sacrifice them (+1 Experience to the Apprentice Sorcerer per slave) or put them to work (+1 wyrdstone per working slave; then roll D12: 3-12 the captive dies and the band keeps his equipment, 1-2 he escapes with his equipment and gains D3 Experience, or +1 if a henchman).

specialRules.name: Uncommon
specialRules.text: Chaos Dwarfs are rare: when rolling to acquire new recruits they pay 1.5 times (rounded up) the normal experience cost. Hobgoblins are not affected.

specialRules.name: Indentured Servants
specialRules.text: The warband must start with at least 4 Hobgoblins; if it drops below 4 no other members may be recruited until it is back to four or more.

specialRules.name: Hired Swords
specialRules.text: May hire Ogre Bodyguard, Pit Fighter, Warlock, Imperial Assassin, Hobgoblin Scout, any Hired Sword described as 'all may hire' or allowed to Orc or Chaos warbands. May never hire Elves of any sort.

equipmentLists.name: Chaos Dwarf equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Apprentice Sorcerer, Bull Centaur, Champions, Chaos Dwarf Warriors

items.name: Obsidian weapon
items.note: Printed as 30 gc/60 gc; the special equipment entry gives 60 gc, Rare 10, Chaos Dwarfs only. Only swords, axes and hammers; as user +1 Strength; -1 Initiative in melee.

items.name: Chaos Dwarf Blunderbuss
items.note: Rare 9, Chaos Dwarfs only. Range 16", Strength 3; Shot: draw a 16" x 1" line, every model in it is hit automatically. Prepare Shot: may only be fired every other turn.

items.name: Poisoned daggers
items.note: Rare 9, Hobgoblins only. Pair (+1 Attack), Swift (+1 Initiative for combat order), permanently poisoned (black lotus), +1 enemy armour save as a dagger (a natural 12 save if none).

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" may use his Leadership when taking Ld tests.

specialRules.name: Rituals of Chaos
specialRules.text: A wizard who learns a random spell from the Chaos Dwarf spell list. If equipped with armour he cannot cast spells.

specialRules.name: Large Target
specialRules.text: Shooters gain +1 to hit and may shoot at it even if it is not the closest target. Adds +20 to the warband rating instead of +5.

fighters.name: Hobgoblin

specialRules.name: Skinny
specialRules.text: On serious injury rolls a result of 1-3 means the Hobgoblin abandons the band.

specialRules.name: Nobody Cares About Them
specialRules.text: Count as half a model for Rout tests. Hobgoblins cannot be heroes; re-roll 'The lad's got talent'.

fighters.notes: Warband must start with at least 4; bought in groups of 1-5.

conversionNotes: Hard to Kill: printed 1-2 knocked down, 3-5 stunned, 6 out of action (d6) -> natural 12 out of action, 1-4 knocked down, 5-11 stunned. The 1-2 -> 1-4 and 3-5 -> 5-11 bands are my judgement.
Slavers: D6 'result of 2 to 6' -> 3-12 and 'result of 1' -> 1-2. Experience bonus D3 left unchanged.
Hobgoblin Skinny: 'serious injury result of 1-3' printed as-is; unclear whether it refers to a d6 or the d66 serious injury chart, please verify against your d12 serious injury table.
Poisoned daggers 'armour save of 6+ if none' -> natural 12 save. True Grit (1-3 KD, 4-5 stunned, 6 OOA) and Thick Skull (3+ -> 5+; 2+ with helmet -> 3+) are special skills, not transcribed here.
Obsidian weapon is printed '30 gc/60 gc' on the list but 60 gc in the special equipment entry (all three weapon types cost the same, 60 gc). listCost 30 recorded; please confirm.
Hobgoblins are Henchmen with min 4 (must include four or more); Chaos Dwarf Warriors max 6; Blunderbuss Chaos Dwarfs max 3.
Special skills tables are recorded as 'Special' (True Grit, Extra Tough, Unlimited Hatred, Thick Skull); Hero skill access from the skill table image.
Maximum profiles (Dwarfs, Bull Centaurs, Hobgoblins) and the spell list text are not part of the schema. The spell list is named 'Chaos Dwarf Magic' (PDF title 'Chaos Dwarfs Magic').
The 'Uncommon' recruiting-experience rule is kept as a warband rule (campaign-only effect).
